gateBoundary.purpose: User visual review of Xiaoju X2 support, cover blockout, physical moment, and control moment evidence.
doesNotAuthorize: Cubism ArtMesh, Deformer, Physics, or runtime edits

requiredReviewArtifacts.role: X2-only bone-length and local triangle constraint diagnostic
reviewFocus: bone segment drift remains visually zero
local forelimb triangle proportions do not cheat the cover motion
diagnostic triangles are not layer boundaries and not formal triangulation

requiredReviewArtifacts.role: direct visual review of paw-to-eye cover path
reviewFocus: paws lift from outside toward eyes
short forelimbs still read as Xiaoju
no visible bone stretch or disconnect

requiredReviewArtifacts.role: contact band and COM support evidence
reviewFocus: hind paws and chest/belly support are plausible
forepaw release does not make body look unsupported
external force and contact directions are legible
shoulder, elbow, and wrist effort distribution is plausible

automaticChecks.note: Automatic checks are consistency evidence only; they do not replace user visual approval.

userReviewQuestions: Does the chest/belly contact band match the intended planet login scene?
When the forepaws release the planet, does the body still look supported?
Do the shoulder, elbow, and wrist bend directions fit Xiaoju's round body and short forelimbs?
Is the paw-center path into the eye cover zone natural, or should left/right paw timing be offset?
Is low-amplitude body compensation enough without ribcage, abdomen, or pelvis collapse?
Does the user confirm that X2 remains only an action/support/moment gate and should not generate formal layers yet?

allowedUserDecisions.effect: Authorize moving to X3 only: complete connected spread-pose / large-character three-view master for the next visual review.
Remain in X2 and revise support, cover blockout, moment preflight, and QA previews.
Remain in X2 and revise only the cited X2 evidence.

approvalEvidence.userPhrase: 没什么问题，继续吧，可以分层了
approvalEvidence.interpretation: Under the corrected PRD sequence, this approves X2 and authorizes X3 spread-pose / large-character three-view master only. Formal layer separation still waits for X3 visual approval.
